title: Her relationship with Basie and Al Killian's wedding
summary: Humes says she was not Basie's girlfriend right away and it never got serious. Basie visited her mother's house in Louisville and once asked about being a son-in-law, but she saw him as only a pleasant companion.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, it must have been an unpleasant experience. Helen, now when you started off going with the Band, and I mean with that taken for granted right away, you as Basie's girlfriend, because the girl singer has got to be somebody's girlfriend right away.
No, I wasn't his girlfriend right away.
No? But after awhile you were his girlfriend?
Yeah.
I mean, that must have made it a little bit more comfortable on the bus for you?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
No.
It didn't make any difference, no?
I don't think it did. Everybody was just as sweet to me as they could be.
That was nice. That was very good. Well then, and you were with Basie a long time?
Yeah.
So, I mean, that was some romance. It got a little serious, didn't it?
No, it didn't get serious with me. He was just there. Sometimes we'd sleep together and sometimes we wouldn't.
Yeah, but . . .

If I want to go somewhere my friends would just come and take me off someplace. But sometimes he wouldn't want me to go. "You can stay here". I said, "You stayin' here?" "No, I got to go". I said, "Go ahead". And I'd go where I had to go, or where I was going. I didn't stand all that.
Yeah, but what about the fact that when he came to Louisville, he came and asked you, talk to your mother?

Well, they had been there before. It's not the first time. Mama would have a big dinner and everything for us, you know. Everybody would just come out there.

So when Al Killian and his wife, they were getting ready to get married, and they wanted to go to Indiana. So they came on and they got married and we stood up for them. And he was asking Mama something about being her son-in-law and she said, 'well I can't help you out there. You got to ask her'. So that was that. I didn't want him for no husband. He was nice as a boyfriend, you know, just being around. Kept me from being lonesome sometimes.
Yeah. I mean, the life that they were leading, they just didn't make very good husbands, did they? Let me see how far along I am.
